domains.description: Core user flows, state transitions, error handling and task completion.
Layout, hierarchy, spacing, typography and reference fidelity.
Intentional desktop/tablet/mobile composition rather than simple shrinkage.
Input, focus, hover, touch and interaction-state correctness.
Purposeful timing, easing, choreography, reduced-motion behavior and cleanup.
WebGL/3D lifecycle, fallback, resource discipline and visual stability when applicable.
WCAG-oriented semantics, keyboard use, focus, contrast and assistive-technology support.
Load/runtime budgets, rendering stability, network weight and interaction latency.
Document landmarks, headings, controls, forms and native semantics.
Metadata, crawl/index fundamentals, structured information and content discoverability.
Trust boundaries, injection/secret risks, dependency/supply-chain and unsafe browser/server behavior.
Data minimization, consent/retention awareness and privacy-safe defaults.
Graceful degradation, error states, no-JS/no-WebGL fallbacks and recovery.
Chromium/Firefox/WebKit compatibility and capability-aware enhancement.
Maintainability, typing, errors, dependency hygiene and implementation clarity.
Boundaries, composition, ownership, extensibility and avoidance of accidental complexity.
Contracts, validation, idempotency, persistence and data consistency when applicable.
Deterministic tests, meaningful assertions, regression evidence and reproducibility.
Candidate-bound evidence, environment correctness, rollback readiness and gate integrity.
Fit to problem, non-generic solution quality, coherent creative thesis and useful differentiation.
